facts: Warranty deed recorded conveying a single-family residential parcel from seller John Q. Public to buyer Jane R. Purchaser, unrelated parties, arm's-length sale through a realtor, stated consideration $285,000. PTA (Form L-4260) filed by the buyer 20 days after closing. No trust, no family relationship between the parties.

expected.notes: Classic arm's-length sale — clear transfer of ownership, no exception category applies; taxable value uncaps to SEV the following year.
